violations.text: Establishment was observed with vacuumed sealed raw meats. Establishment removed vacuum sealer from establishment and voluntarily disposed of vacuumed sealed items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Food items assorted breads for self service sale inside of the establishment did not have ingredients posted. Establishment is to list ingredients and allergens for food items. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer, bone saw) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. No person trained to clean equipment present - equipment must be cleaned and sanitized before being used. New Violation. Correct By: 04/19/2024

Beef was observed held at 72 degrees Fahrenheit stored outside of refrigerator. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Beef was voluntarily disposed of. New Violation. Correct By: 04/18/2024

Raw animal product was observed thawing in the sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Products were moved to refrigerator to continue thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/18/2024
The coving on the wall behind the storage area is missing. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/08/2024
